title: Azad Engineering Limited (NSE: AZAD) — Institutional Underwriting Dossier
sector: Industrials — Precision Aerospace, Defence & Energy Turbine Components
archetype: Capital-Intensive Precision OEM Supplier (116x P/E, Negative FCF)
holding_rationale: AZAD has 0 shares in the consolidated Zerodha IN positions ledger (NOT_HELD). New capital is REJECTED because 116x TTM P/E (~63x EV/EBITDA) prices in 33% CAGR + 18% FCF margins despite -₹119 Cr FY26 CFO, -₹691 Cr FY26 FCF, 304 working-capital days, 11.9% ROCE, and a Stage 3 pullback below the 50-DMA (₹2,706.62).

holding_alerts.trigger: Audited H2 FY27 / FY27 cash-flow print delivers CFO > 50% of EBITDA and Working Capital Days < 180
holding_alerts.instruction: Re-open underwriting only after audited cash conversion turns positive and bill discounting compresses debtor days toward ~90–120 days.

holding_alerts.trigger: Stage 2 high-volume reclaim above ₹2,707 (50-DMA) OR deep valuation reset into ₹1,950–₹2,150
holding_alerts.instruction: Do not catch the Stage 3 drift at ₹2,455.90; wait for both audited FCF inflection and a confirmed Stage 2 accumulation setup.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal INR capital unit under review (AZAD is NOT_HELD in the Zerodha portfolio; 0 shares to trim or exit).

destinations.rationale: Active IN shortlist name in Weinstein Stage 2 with CLEAR_FOR_CONSIDERATION gate (CMP ₹1,984.10, support ₹1,869.54–₹1,957.58, stop ₹1,664.02, 2.36:1 asymmetry to ₹2,650 base target).
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy on pullback into ₹1,869.54–₹1,957.58 support zone with invalidation stop at ₹1,664.02.

destinations.rationale: Stage 2 titanium/superalloy casting peer (CMP ₹24,365, support ₹23,014.68–₹24,566.82, stop ₹19,562.33), but 307x P/E and 8.59% ROCE offer only 0.19:1 asymmetry.
destinations.entry_condition: Pass at 307x P/E; require multi-quarter earnings catch-up before committing fresh capital.

destinations.rationale: Preserve 60% in liquid cash given narrow IN market breadth (Uptrend with 3 distribution days) and AZAD's REJECTED gate.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy only when audited cash-flow proof and Stage 2 breakouts align.

primer: Azad Engineering (NSE: AZAD) manufactures precision-forged airfoils and rotating components for global energy turbines and aerospace OEMs. Its ~₹6,500 Cr order book and 38% TTM operating margin reflect a genuine 1,700-part qualification moat. However, cumulative 6-year CFO is -₹56 Cr (FY26 FCF -₹691 Cr, 304 WC days, 11.9% ROCE). At 116x TTM P/E in Weinstein Stage 3, AZAD earns an independent REJECTED verdict.
